scripts.emulators: node scripts/run.mjs firebase emulators:start --project demo-odisseia --only auth,firestore,hosting
scripts.test:rules: node scripts/run.mjs firebase emulators:exec --project demo-odisseia --only firestore "node --test tests/rules/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/run.mjs firebase emulators:exec --project demo-odisseia --only auth,firestore,hosting "playwright test"
scripts.test: npm run test:rules && npm run test:e2e
